nom: Black Rice Exfoliant and White Rice Ampoule Exfoliant

segments.sensitive: Most reviewers with sensitive skin, including two who say other cleansers usually 'upset' their pores or that they've tried nearly everything without success, report this exfoliant works well without irritation and visibly reduces blackheads within days.
segments.dry: The one reviewer with very dry skin reports it leaves her skin smooth and hydrated, with her only complaint being the scent.

concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report visibly fewer or smaller blackheads and clogged pores, in some cases within a single use or overnight; a couple of reviewers temper this, one saying it dissolves the tops of blackheads and makes them look less severe without fully removing them, and one critical reviewer saying results fell well short of what marketing videos showed.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers, including one with very dry skin, consistently report the exfoliant leaves skin hydrated, soft and dewy rather than stripped, with no dissenting reports of dryness.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers, including two with sensitive skin who say other cleansers usually irritate their pores, report no irritation at all from this product; no reviewer reports it causing redness.
concerns.spots: A few reviewers report visible fading of pigmentation, sun damage or scarring, including one comparing the two variants side by side on a scar and one noting brighter, more even skin tone despite high pigmentation; results are generally described as gradual rather than an instant peel.
concerns.oiliness: The one reviewer who addresses this specifically says it removes oil from the skin, alongside dissolving the tops of blackheads.

aspects.libelle: Pleasant, food-like scent, often compared to cookies or spice
A couple find the scent overwhelmingly strong, needing a rewash
Visible effect after just one use for many
Results fall short of the dramatic effect shown in marketing videos
Wipes off easily without harsh scrubbing

This ampoule is a great choice if you want smooth skin without the harshness of a traditional scrub. It’s very hydrating and absorbs quickly, leaving a nice glow thanks to the niacinamide and rice bran. It's gentle enough for sensitive skin and daily use, though you’ll need to use it consistently for a few days to really notice a change in texture—great value for the size, but better for gradual brightening than an instant peel.
